newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak one-year bond avg yield 9.16 percent.
newsitem.headline: Slovak one-year bond avg yield 9.16 percent.

text.p: The average accepted yield at an auction of one-year Slovak government bonds was 9.16 percent, the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Tuesday.
In the government's last completed auction of similar bonds on August 20, the average yield was 8.94 percent.
The NBS accepted bids worth 2.18 billion crowns out of total bids of 4.58 billion crowns, it said in a statment.

"Thus, last year's state budget deficit is covered now, and we presume there will be no more state bond issues this year as there are no legal reasons for them," Stefan Bak, of the NBS Bank Transactions department told Reuters.
Total demand (in nominal value): 4.580 billion crowns
Accepted demand (in nominal value): 2.179 billion crowns
